  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case' app l r ihl ihr =>
    cases ihl rfl with
    | inr red => exact .inr ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 red.choose_spec⟩
    | inl vl =>
        cases ihr rfl with
        | inr red => exact .inr ⟨_, .appᵣ vl red.choose_spec⟩
        | inl vr =>
            obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := canonical_form_abs vl l
            exact .inr ⟨_, .abs vl.lc vr⟩
  case' tapp der sub ih =>
    cases ih rfl with
    | inr red => exact .inr ⟨_, .tapp sub.wf.2.1.lc red.choose_spec⟩
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := canonical_form_tabs val der
        exact .inr ⟨_, .tabs val.lc sub.wf.2.1.lc⟩
  case' let' L der h ih _ =>
    have ⟨_, b⟩ := body_let.mp (Typing.let' L der h).wf.2.1
    cases ih rfl with
    | inr red => exact .inr ⟨_, .let_bind red.choose_spec b⟩
    | inl val => exact .inr ⟨_, .let_body val b⟩
  case' inl _ _ ih => exact (ih rfl).imp Value.inl fun red => ⟨_, .inl red.choose_spec⟩
  case' inr _ _ ih => exact (ih rfl).imp Value.inr fun red => ⟨_, .inr red.choose_spec⟩
  case' case L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have ⟨_, b₂, b₃⟩ := body_case.mp (Typing.case L der h₂ h₃).wf.2.1
    cases ih rfl with
    | inr red => exact .inr ⟨_, .case red.choose_spec b₂ b₃⟩
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, rfl|rfl⟩ := canonical_form_sum val der
        · cases val with | inl val => exact .inr ⟨_, .case_inl val b₂ b₃⟩
        · cases val with | inr val => exact .inr ⟨_, .case_inr val b₂ b₃⟩
  case' sub _ _ ih => exact ih rfl
  case' abs L h _ => exact .inl (.abs ((Typing.abs L h).wf).2.1)
  case' tabs L h _ => exact .inl (.tabs ((Typing.tabs L h).wf).2.1)

/-! # λ-calculus

The λ-calculus with polymorphism and subtyping, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
This file proves type safety.

## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
* See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
  this is adapted

-/

public section

namespace Cslib

variable {Var : Type*} [HasFresh Var] [DecidableEq Var]

namespace LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub

open Context List Env.Wf Term Ty

variable {t : Term Var}

/-- Any reduction step preserves typing. -/
lemma Typing.preservation (der : Typing Γ t τ) (step : t ⭢βᵛ t') : Typing Γ t' τ := by
  induction der generalizing t'
  case app Γ _ σ τ _ _ _ _ _ =>
    cases step
    case appₗ | appᵣ => grind
    case abs der _ _ =>
      have sub : Sub Γ (σ.arrow τ) (σ.arrow τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
      have ⟨_, _, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.abs_inv sub
      grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm, Sub.weaken]
  case tapp Γ _ σ τ σ' _ _ _ =>
    cases step
    case tabs der _ _ =>
      have sub : Sub Γ (σ.all τ) (σ.all τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
      have ⟨_, _, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.tabs_inv sub
      have ⟨X, mem⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [Ty.fv, fvTy] Var
      simp at mem
      have : Γ = (Context.mapVal (·[X := σ']) []) ++ Γ := by grind
      rw [openTy_substTy_intro (X := X), open_subst_intro (X := X)] <;> grind [subst_ty]
    case tapp => grind
  case let' Γ _ _ _ _ L der _ ih₁ _ =>
    cases step
    case let_bind red₁ _ => apply Typing.let' L (ih₁ red₁); grind
    case let_body =>
      grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm]
  case case Γ _ σ τ _ _ _ L _ _ _ ih₁ _ _ =>
    have sub : Sub Γ (σ.sum τ) (σ.sum τ) := by grind [Sub.refl]
    have : Γ = [] ++ Γ := by rfl
    cases step
    case «case» red₁ _ _ => apply Typing.case L (ih₁ red₁) <;> grind
    case case_inl der _ _ =>
      have ⟨_, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := der.inl_inv sub
      grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, openTm_substTm_intro, subst_tm]

  | inr : Typing Γ t₁ τ → σ.Wf Γ → Typing Γ (inr t₁) (sum σ τ)

variable {Var : Type*}

namespace LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub

namespace Term

/-- Existential predicate for being a locally closed body of an abstraction. -/
@[scoped grind =]
def body (t : Term Var) := ∃ L : Finset Var, ∀ x ∉ L, LC (t ^ᵗᵗ fvar x)

section

variable {t₁ t₂ t₃ : Term Var}

variable [DecidableEq Var]

/-- Locally closed let bindings have a locally closed body. -/
@[scoped grind _=_]
lemma body_let : (let' t₁ t₂).LC ↔ t₁.LC ∧ t₂.body := by
  constructor <;> intro h <;> cases h
  case mp.let' L t₁_lc h => exact ⟨t₁_lc, L, h⟩
  case mpr.intro body =>
    obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := body
    grind [LC.let' <| free_union Var]

/-- Locally closed case bindings have a locally closed bodies. -/
@[scoped grind _=_]
lemma body_case : (case t₁ t₂ t₃).LC ↔ t₁.LC ∧ t₂.body ∧ t₃.body := by
  constructor <;> intro h
  case mp => cases h with | case L t₁_lc h₂ h₃ => exact ⟨t₁_lc, ⟨L, h₂⟩, ⟨L, h₃⟩⟩
  case mpr =>
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩⟩ := h
    grind [LC.case <| free_union Var]

variable [HasFresh Var]

/-- Opening a body preserves local closure. -/
@[scoped grind <=]
lemma open_tm_body (body : t₁.body) (lc : t₂.LC) : (t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂).LC := by
  cases body
  grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [fvTm] Var, substTm_lc, openTm_substTm_intro]

end

@[grind]
inductive Value : Term Var → Prop
  | abs : LC (abs σ t₁) → Value (abs σ t₁)
  | tabs : LC (tabs σ t₁) → Value (tabs σ t₁)
  | inl : Value t₁ → Value (inl t₁)
  | inr : Value t₁ → Value (inr t₁)

@[grind →]
lemma Value.lc {t : Term Var} (val : t.Value) : t.LC := by
  induction val <;> grind

@[grind, reduction_sys "βᵛ"]
inductive Red : Term Var → Term Var → Prop

  | inr : Red t₁ t₁' → Red (inr t₁) (inr t₁')

  | fvar : Var → Ty Var
  /-- A function type. -/
  | arrow : Ty Var → Ty Var → Ty Var
  /-- A universal quantification. -/
  | all : Ty Var → Ty Var → Ty Var
  /-- A sum type. -/
  | sum : Ty Var → Ty Var → Ty Var
  deriving Inhabited

/-- Syntax of locally nameless lambda terms, with free variables over `Var`. -/
inductive Term (Var : Type*)
  /-- Bound term variables that appear under a lambda abstraction, using a de-Bruijn index. -/
  | bvar : ℕ → Term Var
  /-- Free term variables. -/
  | fvar : Var → Term Var
  /-- Lambda abstraction, introducing a new bound term variable. -/
  | abs : Ty Var → Term Var → Term Var
  /-- Function application. -/
  | app : Term Var → Term Var → Term Var
  /-- Type abstraction, introducing a new bound type variable. -/
  | tabs : Ty Var → Term Var → Term Var
  /-- Type application. -/
  | tapp : Term Var → Ty Var → Term Var
  /-- Binding of a term. -/
  | let' : Term Var → Term Var → Term Var
  /-- Left constructor of a sum. -/
  | inl : Term Var → Term Var
  /-- Right constructor of a sum. -/
  | inr : Term Var → Term Var
  /-- Case matching on a sum. -/
  | case : Term Var → Term Var → Term Var → Term Var

/-- A context binding. -/
inductive Binding (Var : Type*)
  /-- Subtype binding. -/
  | sub : Ty Var → Binding Var
  /-- Type binding. -/
  | ty : Ty Var → Binding Var
  deriving Inhabited

/-- Free variables of a type. -/
@[scoped grind =]
def Ty.fv : Ty Var → Finset Var
| top | bvar _ => {}
| fvar X => {X}
| arrow σ τ | all σ τ | sum σ τ => σ.fv ∪ τ.fv

/-- Free variables of a binding. -/
@[scoped grind =]
def Binding.fv : Binding Var → Finset Var
| sub σ | ty σ => σ.fv

/-- Free type variables of a term. -/
@[scoped grind =]
def Term.fvTy : Term Var → Finset Var
| bvar _ | fvar _ => {}
| abs σ t₁ | tabs σ t₁ | tapp t₁ σ => σ.fv ∪ t₁.fvTy
| inl t₁ | inr t₁ => t₁.fvTy
| app t₁ t₂ | let' t₁ t₂ => t₁.fvTy ∪ t₂.fvTy
| case t₁ t₂ t₃ => t₁.fvTy ∪ t₂.fvTy ∪ t₃.fvTy

/-- Free term variables of a term. -/
@[scoped grind =]
def Term.fvTm : Term Var → Finset Var
| bvar _ => {}
| fvar x => {x}
| abs _ t₁ | tabs _ t₁ | tapp t₁ _ | inl t₁ | inr t₁ => t₁.fvTm
| app t₁ t₂ | let' t₁ t₂ => t₁.fvTm ∪ t₂.fvTm
| case t₁ t₂ t₃ => t₁.fvTm ∪ t₂.fvTm ∪ t₃.fvTm

/-- A context of bindings. -/
abbrev Env (Var : Type*) := Context Var (Binding Var)

end LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub

end Cslib

module

public import Cslib.Languages.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc.Basic
public import Cslib.Languages.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.FullBeta
public import Cslib.Foundations.Relation.Confluence

/-! # λ-calculus

Type safety of the simply typed λ-calculus, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
Theorems in this file are namespaced by their respective reductions.

## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
* See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
  this is partially adapted

-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Cslib

universe u v

namespace LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc

open Untyped Typing

variable {Var : Type u} {Base : Type v} {R : Term Var → Term Var → Prop}

/-- A relation on terms preserves typing if all related terms have the same type. -/
def PreservesTyping (R : Term Var → Term Var → Prop) (Base : Type v) :=
  ∀ {Γ t t'} {τ : Ty Base}, Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ → R t t' → Γ ⊢ t' ∶ τ

/-- If a reduction preserves types, so does its reflexive transitive closure. -/
@[scoped grind →]
theorem redex_preservesTyping :
    PreservesTyping R Base → PreservesTyping (Relation.ReflTransGen R) Base := by
  intros _ _ _ _ _ _ redex
  induction redex <;> [grind; aesop]


open _root_.Relation in
/-- Confluence preserves type preservation. -/
theorem confluence_preservesTyping {τ : Ty Base}
    (con : Confluent R) (p : PreservesTyping R Base) (der : Γ ⊢ a ∶ τ)
    (ab : ReflTransGen R a b) (ac : ReflTransGen R a c) :
    ∃ d, ReflTransGen R b d ∧ ReflTransGen R c d ∧ Γ ⊢ d ∶ τ := by
  have ⟨d, bd, cd⟩ := con ab ac
  exact ⟨d, bd, cd, redex_preservesTyping p der (ab.trans bd)⟩

variable [HasFresh Var] [DecidableEq Var] {Γ : Context Var (Ty Base)}

namespace FullBeta

open LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term FullBeta

set_option linter.unusedDecidableInType false in
/-- Typing preservation for full beta reduction. -/
@[scoped grind →]
theorem preservation (der : Γ ⊢ t ∶ τ) (step : t ⭢βᶠ t') : Γ ⊢ t' ∶ τ := by
  induction der generalizing t' <;> cases step
  case abs.abs xs _ _ _ xs' _ => apply Typing.abs (free_union Var); grind
  case app.base h der _ _ der_l =>
    cases der_l
    cases h with | abs _ cofin => exact preservation_open cofin der
  all_goals grind

open scoped Term in
omit [HasFresh Var] [DecidableEq Var] in
/-- A typed term either full beta reduces or is a value. -/
theorem progress {t : Term Var} {τ : Ty Base} (ht : [] ⊢ t ∶ τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᶠ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at ht
  induction ht
  case var => simp_all
  case abs xs mem ih =>
    left
    constructor
    apply Term.LC.abs xs
    intros _ mem'
    exact (mem _ mem').lc
  case app Γ M σ τ N der_l der_r ih_l ih_r =>
    simp only [eq, forall_const] at *
    right
    cases ih_l with
    -- if the lhs is a value, beta reduce the application
    | inl val => cases val with | abs M _ => use M ^ N, by grind
    -- otherwise, propagate the step to the lhs of the application
    | inr step =>
      obtain ⟨M', _⟩ := step
      use M'.app N
      grind

end FullBeta

end LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Stlc

end Cslib

module
prelude
public import Lean.Elab.Term
import Lean.Elab.Binders
namespace Lean.Elab.Tactic
public def renameInaccessibles (mvarId : MVarId) (hs : TSyntaxArray ``binderIdent) : TermElabM MVarId := do
  if hs.isEmpty then
    return mvarId
  else
    let mvarDecl ← mvarId.getDecl
    let mut lctx  := mvarDecl.lctx
    let mut hs    := hs
    let mut info  := #[]
    let mut found : NameSet := {}
    let n := lctx.numIndices
    -- hypotheses are inaccessible if their scopes are different from the caller's (we assume that
    -- the scopes are the same for all the hypotheses in `hs`, which is reasonable to expect in
    -- practice and otherwise the expected semantics of `rename_i` really are not clear)
    let some callerScopes := hs.findSome? (fun
        | `(binderIdent| $h:ident) => some <| extractMacroScopes h.getId
        | _ => none)
      | return mvarId
    for i in *...n do
      let j := n - i - 1
      match lctx.getAt? j with
      | none => pure ()
      | some localDecl =>
        if localDecl.isImplementationDetail then
          continue
        let inaccessible := !(extractMacroScopes localDecl.userName |>.equalScope callerScopes)
        let shadowed := found.contains localDecl.userName
        if inaccessible || shadowed then
          if let `(binderIdent| $h:ident) := hs.back! then
            let newName := h.getId
            lctx := lctx.setUserName localDecl.fvarId newName
            info := info.push (localDecl.fvarId, h)
          hs := hs.pop
          if hs.isEmpty then
            break
        found := found.insert localDecl.userName
    unless hs.isEmpty do
      logError m!"too many variable names provided"
    let mvarNew ← Meta.mkFreshExprMVarAt lctx mvarDecl.localInstances mvarDecl.type MetavarKind.syntheticOpaque mvarDecl.userName
    withSaveInfoContext <| mvarNew.mvarId!.withContext do
      for (fvarId, stx) in info do
        Term.addLocalVarInfo stx (mkFVar fvarId)
    mvarId.assign mvarNew
    return mvarNew.mvarId!

end Lean.Elab.Tactic

module

public import Cslib.Languages.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Opening

/-! # λ-calculus

The λ-calculus with polymorphism and subtyping, with a locally nameless representation of syntax.
This file defines the well-formedness condition for types and contexts.

## References

* [A. Chargueraud, *The Locally Nameless Representation*][Chargueraud2012]
* See also <https://www.cis.upenn.edu/~plclub/popl08-tutorial/code/>, from which
  this is adapted

-/

@[expose] public section

namespace Cslib

variable {Var : Type*} [DecidableEq Var]

namespace LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub

open scoped Ty in
/-- A type is well-formed when it is locally closed and all free variables appear in a context. -/
inductive Ty.Wf : Env Var → Ty Var → Prop
  | top : Ty.Wf Γ top
  | var : Binding.sub σ ∈ Γ.dlookup X → Ty.Wf Γ (fvar X)
  | arrow : Ty.Wf Γ σ → Ty.Wf Γ τ → Ty.Wf Γ (arrow σ τ)
  | all (L : Finset Var) :
      Ty.Wf Γ σ →
      (∀ X ∉ L, Ty.Wf (⟨X,Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ) (τ ^ᵞ fvar X)) →
      Ty.Wf Γ (all σ τ)
  | sum : Ty.Wf Γ σ → Ty.Wf Γ τ → Ty.Wf Γ (sum σ τ)

attribute [scoped grind! .] Ty.Wf.top Ty.Wf.var Ty.Wf.arrow Ty.Wf.sum

/-- An environment is well-formed if it binds each variable exactly once to a well-formed type. -/
inductive Env.Wf : Env Var → Prop
  | empty : Wf []
  | sub : Wf Γ → τ.Wf Γ → X ∉ Γ.dom → Wf (⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Γ)
  | ty : Wf Γ → τ.Wf Γ → x ∉ Γ.dom → Wf (⟨x, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Γ)

attribute [scoped grind! .] Env.Wf.sub Env.Wf.ty

variable {Γ Δ Θ : Env Var} {σ τ τ' γ δ : Ty Var}

open scoped Context in
/-- A well-formed context contains no duplicate keys. -/
@[scoped grind →]
lemma Env.Wf.to_ok {Γ : Env Var} (wf : Γ.Wf) : Γ✓ := by
  induction wf <;> constructor <;> first | assumption | grind [List.mem_keys_of_mem]

namespace Ty.Wf

open Context List Binding
open scoped Env.Wf

/-- A well-formed type is locally closed. -/
@[grind →]
theorem lc (wf : σ.Wf Γ) : σ.LC := by
  induction wf with
  | all => grind [LC.all (free_union Var)]
  | _ => grind

/-- A type remains well-formed under context permutation. -/
theorem perm_env (wf : σ.Wf Γ) (perm : Γ ~ Δ) (ok_Γ : Γ✓) (ok_Δ : Δ✓) : σ.Wf Δ := by
  induction wf generalizing Δ with
  | all => grind [all <| free_union [dom] Var, Perm.cons, nodupKeys_cons]
  | _ => grind [perm_dlookup]

/-- A type remains well-formed under context weakening (in the middle). -/
theorem weaken (wf_ΓΘ : σ.Wf (Γ ++ Θ)) (ok_ΓΔΘ : (Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ)✓) : σ.Wf (Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ) := by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ Θ = ΓΔ at wf_ΓΘ
  induction wf_ΓΘ generalizing Γ
  case all => apply all ((Γ ++ Δ ++ Θ).dom ∪ free_union Var) <;> grind [-keys_append]
  all_goals grind [NodupKeys.sublist, <= sublist_dlookup]

/-- A type remains well-formed under context weakening (at the front). -/
theorem weaken_head (wf : σ.Wf Δ) (ok : (Γ ++ Δ)✓) : σ.Wf (Γ ++ Δ) := by
  have : Γ ++ Δ = [] ++ Γ ++ Δ := by rfl
  grind [weaken]

theorem weaken_cons (wf : σ.Wf Δ) (ok : (⟨X, b⟩ :: Δ)✓) : σ.Wf (⟨X, b⟩:: Δ) := by
  grind [weaken_head]

/-- A type remains well-formed under context narrowing. -/
lemma narrow (wf : σ.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (ok : (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ)✓) :
    σ.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ) := by
  generalize eq : (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ) = Θ at wf
  induction wf generalizing Γ with
  | all => apply all (free_union [dom] Var) <;> grind [nodupKeys_cons]
  | _ =>
    #adaptation_note
    /--
    Moving from `nightly-2025-09-15` to `nightly-2025-10-19`,
    I've had to remove the `append_assoc` lemma from grind;
    without this `grind` is exploding. This requires further investigation.
    -/
    grind [sublist_dlookup, -append_assoc]

lemma narrow_cons (wf : σ.Wf (⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (ok : (⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ)✓) :
    σ.Wf (⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ) := by
  grind [List.nil_append (⟨X, sub τ'⟩ :: Δ), narrow]

/-- A type remains well-formed under context strengthening. -/
lemma strengthen (wf : σ.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Δ)) : σ.Wf (Γ ++ Δ) := by
  generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Δ = Θ at wf
  induction wf generalizing Γ with
  | all => grind [all <| free_union [Context.dom] Var]
  | _ => grind

variable [HasFresh Var] in
/-- A type remains well-formed under context substitution (of a well-formed type). -/
lemma map_subst (wf_σ : σ.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (wf_τ' : τ'.Wf Δ)
    (ok : (Γ.mapVal (·[X := τ']) ++ Δ)✓) : σ[X := τ'].Wf <| Γ.mapVal (·[X := τ']) ++ Δ := by
  have := @mapVal_mem Var (Binding Var)
  generalize eq : Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ = Θ at wf_σ
  induction wf_σ generalizing Γ τ' with
  | all => apply all (free_union [dom] Var) <;> grind [open_subst_var]
  | _ => grind [weaken_head]

variable [HasFresh Var] in
/-- A type remains well-formed under opening (to a well-formed type). -/
lemma open_lc (ok_Γ : Γ✓) (wf_all : (Ty.all σ τ).Wf Γ) (wf_δ : δ.Wf Γ) : (τ ^ᵞ δ).Wf Γ := by
  cases wf_all with | all =>
    let ⟨X, _⟩ := fresh_exists <| free_union [fv, Context.dom] Var
    have : Γ = Context.mapVal (·[X := δ]) [] ++ Γ := by grind
    grind [open_subst_intro, map_subst]

/-- A type bound in a context is well formed. -/
lemma of_bind_ty (wf : Γ.Wf) (bind : Binding.ty σ ∈ Γ.dlookup X) : σ.Wf Γ := by
  induction wf <;> grind [weaken_head]

/-- A type at the head of a well-formed context is well-formed. -/
lemma of_env_ty (wf : Env.Wf (⟨X, Binding.ty σ⟩ :: Γ)) : σ.Wf Γ := by
  cases wf
  assumption

/-- A subtype at the head of a well-formed context is well-formed. -/
lemma of_env_sub (wf : Env.Wf (⟨X, Binding.sub σ⟩ :: Γ)) : σ.Wf Γ := by
  cases wf
  assumption

variable [HasFresh Var] in
/-- A variable not appearing in a context does not appear in its well-formed types. -/
lemma nmem_fv {σ : Ty Var} (wf : σ.Wf Γ) (nmem : X ∉ Γ.dom) : X ∉ σ.fv := by
  induction wf with
  | all => grind [fresh_exists <| free_union [dom] Var, nmem_fv_open, openRec_lc]
  | @var _ Γ => grind => have : (dlookup X Γ).isSome = true; finish;
  | _ => grind

end Ty.Wf

namespace Env.Wf

open Context List Binding

/-- A context remains well-formed under narrowing (of a well-formed subtype). -/
lemma narrow (wf_env : Env.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (wf_τ' : τ'.Wf Δ) :
    Env.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ'⟩ :: Δ) := by
  induction Γ <;> cases wf_env <;>
  grind [Ty.Wf.narrow, eq_nil_of_append_eq_nil, cases Env.Wf]

/-- A context remains well-formed under strengthening. -/
lemma strengthen (wf : Env.Wf <| Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.ty τ⟩ :: Δ) : Env.Wf <| Γ ++ Δ := by
  induction Γ <;> cases wf <;> grind [Ty.Wf.strengthen]

variable [HasFresh Var] in
/-- A context remains well-formed under substitution (of a well-formed type). -/
lemma map_subst (wf_env : Env.Wf (Γ ++ ⟨X, Binding.sub τ⟩ :: Δ)) (wf_τ' : τ'.Wf Δ) :
    Env.Wf <| Γ.mapVal (·[X := τ']) ++ Δ := by
  induction Γ generalizing wf_τ' Δ τ' <;> cases wf_env
  case nil => grind
  case cons.sub | cons.ty => constructor <;> grind [Ty.Wf.map_subst]

variable [HasFresh Var]

/-- A well-formed context is unchanged by substituting for a free key. -/
lemma map_subst_nmem (Γ : Env Var) (X : Var) (σ : Ty Var) (wf : Γ.Wf) (nmem : X ∉ Γ.dom) :
    Γ = Γ.mapVal (·[X := σ]) := by
  induction wf <;> grind [Ty.Wf.nmem_fv, Binding.subst_fresh]

end Env.Wf

+++ b/src/proof_eval/harness/archived_schedules.py
@@ -0,0 +1,80 @@
+"""Read-only identity and pricing compatibility for retired mixed-model runs."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import asdict
+from typing import Sequence
+
+from proof_eval.providers.codex import MODELS
+from proof_eval.providers.costs import CostConfig, generations_cost
+
+
+def validate_archive(config: dict) -> None:
+    """Validate saved schedule metadata without permitting another model call."""
+    first = config.get("first_attempt_condition")
+    if first is None:
+        return
+    if not (
+        config.get("provider") == "codex"
+        and config.get("mode") == "score_edges"
+        and len(config["conditions"]) == 1
+        and config.get("budget_tracking") == "cost"
+        and isinstance(first, (tuple, list))
+        and len(first) == 2
+        and first[1] in MODELS.get(first[0], set())
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Invalid archived mixed-model condition")
+
+
+def attempt_condition(
+    config: dict, model: str, effort: str, number: int
+) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Recover the expected identity for an archived request or cost estimate."""
+    if number == 0 and config.get("first_attempt_condition") is not None:
+        return tuple(config["first_attempt_condition"])
+    return model, effort
+
+
+def archived_generations_cost(
+    configurations: Sequence[CostConfig],
+    generations: Sequence[dict],
+    *,
+    budget_usd: float = 3.0,
+) -> dict:
+    """Reproduce the retired schedule's recorded cost schema for offline audit."""
+    if len(configurations) != len(generations):
+        raise ValueError("Each generation requires its archived cost configuration")
+    costs = [
+        generations_cost(config, [generation], budget_usd=budget_usd)
+        for config, generation in zip(configurations, generations)
+    ]
+    unknown = [i for i, cost in enumerate(costs) if cost["total_usd"] is None]
+    known = [cost.get("known_usage_estimate", cost) for cost in costs]
+    known_total = sum(cost.get("total_usd") or 0.0 for cost in known)
+    total = None if unknown or not costs else known_total
+    return {
+        "status": "unknown_usage" if total is None else "estimated",
+        "basis": "public_api_equivalent",
+        "configurations": [asdict(config) for config in configurations],
+        "attempt_costs": costs,
+        "attempts": len(costs),
+        "total_usd": total,
+        "budget_usd": budget_usd,
+        "remaining_usd_at_assumed_rates": None if total is None else budget_usd - total,
+        "over_budget_at_assumed_rates": (
+            None if total is None else total > budget_usd + 1e-12
+        ),
+        "unknown_attempt_indices": unknown,
+        "known_usage_estimate": {"total_usd": known_total},
+        "all_uncached_as_cache_writes_usd": sum(
+            cost.get("all_uncached_as_cache_writes_usd", 0.0) for cost in known
+        ),
+        "all_requests_long_context_usd": sum(
+            cost.get("all_requests_long_context_usd", 0.0) for cost in known
+        ),
+        "assumptions": [
+            "Each attempt uses the frozen rates for its scheduled model and effort.",
+            "All attempts share one problem budget; missing usage remains unknown.",
+            "API-equivalent estimates are not invoices or hard cost ceilings.",
+        ],
+    }

+

+
+
+def resolve_usage_policy(
+    policy: UsagePolicy | None, provider: str, tracking: str | None
+) -> UsagePolicy:
+    """New Codex cost runs estimate missing usage; historical configs stay strict."""
+    if policy is None:
+        return "best_effort" if provider == "codex" and tracking == "cost" else "strict"

+        raise ValueError("Best-effort usage estimates require Codex cost tracking")
+    return policy

@@ -0,0 +1,496 @@
+"""Reconcile native Codex request traces with terminal usage, including retries.
+
+The regular exec stream hides some retries and drops counters on failed turns.
+Keep reported counters separate from explicit heuristics for missing usage; strict
+accounting remains unknown when a request has no complete counters.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import re
+from math import ceil
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from proof_eval.evidence.io import digest, fingerprint, read, write_json
+
+from .costs import USAGE_FIELDS, normalize_token_usage
+
+SCHEMA_VERSION = 2
+TRACE_DIRECTORY = "workspace/native_trace"
+
+
+def rejected_request(error: str) -> bool:
+    """Only explicit admission refusals, never generic stream/network failures."""
+    # Codex also renders generic HTTP 500 errors as "high demand". Neither
+    # that message nor a generic 503 proves refusal before model processing.
+    return error == (
+        "Selected model is at capacity. Please try a different model."
+    ) or bool(re.match(r"^unexpected status 429\b", error))
+
+
+def _collect_usage_v1(folder: Path, events: list[dict], model: str) -> dict:
+    """Rebuild historical accounting with its original compaction stop behavior."""
+    folder = folder.resolve()
+    files: dict[str, str] = {}
+    record = {"schema_version": 1, "files": files, "requests": []}
+
+    def saved(path: Path) -> object:
+        path = path.resolve(strict=True)
+        if not path.is_relative_to((folder / TRACE_DIRECTORY).resolve()):
+            raise ValueError("Native usage payload escapes its trace directory")
+        files[str(path.relative_to(folder))] = digest(path)
+        return read(path)
+
+    try:
+        manifests = list((folder / TRACE_DIRECTORY).glob("*/manifest.json"))
+        if len(manifests) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Expected one native usage trace")
+        manifest = saved(manifests[0])
+        threads = [e["thread_id"] for e in events if e.get("type") == "thread.started"]
+        if (
+            manifest["schema_version"] != 1
+            or threads != [manifest["root_thread_id"]]
+            or manifest["raw_event_log"] != "trace.jsonl"
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Native usage trace identity does not match the exec stream"
+            )
+        record["thread_id"] = threads[0]
+        trace_path = manifests[0].parent / "trace.jsonl"
+        files[str(trace_path.relative_to(folder))] = digest(trace_path)
+        rows = [json.loads(line) for line in trace_path.read_text().splitlines()]
+        if not rows or rows[-1]["payload"]["type"] != "rollout_ended":
+            raise ValueError("Native usage trace has no terminal rollout record")
+        requests: dict[str, dict] = {}
+        for seq, row in enumerate(rows, 1):
+            if (
+                row["schema_version"] != 1
+                or row["seq"] != seq
+                or row["rollout_id"] != manifest["rollout_id"]
+                or row.get("thread_id") not in (None, threads[0])
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Native usage trace order or identity changed")
+            payload = row["payload"]
+            kind = payload["type"]
+            if kind == "thread_started" and payload["thread_id"] != threads[0]:
+                raise ValueError("Unexpected child thread in native usage trace")
+            if kind.startswith("compaction_request_"):
+                raise ValueError("Compaction usage is not covered by inference tracing")
+            if not kind.startswith("inference_"):
+                continue
+            call_id = payload["inference_call_id"]
+            if kind == "inference_started":
+                if call_id in requests or payload["model"] != model:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "Duplicate request or changed model in usage trace"
+                    )
+                requests[call_id] = {"call_id": call_id, "status": "started"}
+                record["requests"].append(requests[call_id])
+                continue
+            request = requests[call_id]
+            if request["status"] != "started":
+                raise ValueError("Duplicate native request terminal record")
+            if kind == "inference_completed":
+                response = saved(
+                    manifests[0].parent / payload["response_payload"]["path"]
+                )
+                if response["response_id"] != payload["response_id"]:
+                    raise ValueError("Native response identity changed")
+                request.update(
+                    status="completed",
+                    response_id=payload["response_id"],
+                    usage=normalize_token_usage(response["token_usage"]),
+                )
+            elif kind in ("inference_failed", "inference_cancelled"):
+                error = payload.get("error", payload.get("reason", ""))
+                request.update(status="unknown", error=error)
+                if (
+                    kind == "inference_failed"
+                    and payload.get("partial_response_payload") is None
+                    and rejected_request(error)
+                ):
+                    request["status"] = "rejected"
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("Unsupported native inference record")
+        if not requests:
+            raise ValueError("Native usage trace contains no requests")
+        total = dict.fromkeys(USAGE_FIELDS, 0)
+        for request in requests.values():
+            for key, value in request.get("usage", {}).items():
+                total[key] += value
+        record["token_usage"] = total
+        turns = [e for e in events if e.get("type") == "turn.completed"]
+        if turns and (
+            len(turns) != 1 or normalize_token_usage(turns[0].get("usage")) != total
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Native request counters do not match terminal counters")
+        unknown = [
+            r["call_id"]
+            for r in requests.values()
+            if r["status"] in ("unknown", "started")
+        ]
+        record.update(complete=not unknown, unknown_request_ids=unknown)
+        if unknown:
+            record["reason"] = (
+                "Interrupted native requests have no complete usage counters"
+            )
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
+        record.update(complete=False, reason=str(error))
+    return record
+
+
+def collect_usage(
+    folder: Path,
+    events: list[dict],
+    model: str,
+    *,
+    schema_version: int = SCHEMA_VERSION,
+) -> dict:
+    """Retain known counters and evidence even when other requests lack usage."""
+    if schema_version == 1:
+        return _collect_usage_v1(folder, events, model)
+    if schema_version != SCHEMA_VERSION:
+        raise ValueError("Unsupported native response usage schema")
+    folder = folder.resolve()
+    files: dict[str, str] = {}
+    requests: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
+    request_payloads: dict[tuple[str, str], object] = {}
+    record = {"schema_version": schema_version, "files": files, "requests": []}
+    reason = None
+
+    def saved(path: Path) -> object:
+        path = path.resolve(strict=True)
+        if not path.is_relative_to((folder / TRACE_DIRECTORY).resolve()):
+            raise ValueError("Native usage payload escapes its trace directory")
+        files[str(path.relative_to(folder))] = digest(path)
+        return read(path)
+
+    def estimate(request: dict, key: tuple[str, str], response: object) -> None:
+        # Compaction history and its response may contain encrypted text. Their
+        # serialized size is an explicit heuristic, not an observed token count
+        # or a certified upper bound. Cache/reasoning attribution is unreported.
+        def tokens(payload: object) -> int:
+            serialized = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
+            return ceil(len(serialized.encode("utf-8")) / 4)
+
+        request.update(
+            estimated_usage={
+                **dict.fromkeys(USAGE_FIELDS, 0),
+                "input_tokens": tokens(request_payloads[key]),
+                "output_tokens": 0 if response is None else tokens(response),
+            },
+            estimation_basis="canonical_json_utf8_bytes_divided_by_four_uncached",
+        )
+
+    try:
+        manifests = list((folder / TRACE_DIRECTORY).glob("*/manifest.json"))
+        if len(manifests) != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Expected one native usage trace")
+        manifest = saved(manifests[0])
+        threads = [e["thread_id"] for e in events if e.get("type") == "thread.started"]
+        if (
+            manifest["schema_version"] != 1
+            or threads != [manifest["root_thread_id"]]
+            or manifest["raw_event_log"] != "trace.jsonl"
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Native usage trace identity does not match the exec stream"
+            )
+        record["thread_id"] = threads[0]
+        trace_path = manifests[0].parent / "trace.jsonl"
+        files[str(trace_path.relative_to(folder))] = digest(trace_path)
+        lines = trace_path.read_text().splitlines()
+        last_row = None
+        # Scan the full trace before validating its end. Completed responses remain
+        # useful evidence when a later request or the native process is interrupted.
+        for seq, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
+            row = json.loads(line)
+            last_row = row
+            if (
+                row["schema_version"] != 1
+                or row["seq"] != seq
+                or row["rollout_id"] != manifest["rollout_id"]
+                or row.get("thread_id") not in (None, threads[0])
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Native usage trace order or identity changed")
+            payload = row["payload"]
+            kind = payload["type"]
+            if kind == "thread_started" and payload["thread_id"] != threads[0]:
+                raise ValueError("Unexpected child thread in native usage trace")
+            if kind == "compaction_installed":
+                saved(manifests[0].parent / payload["checkpoint_payload"]["path"])
+                continue
+            if kind.startswith("inference_"):
+                request_kind, prefix, id_key = (
+                    "inference",
+                    "inference_",
+                    "inference_call_id",
+                )
+            elif kind.startswith("compaction_request_"):
+                request_kind, prefix, id_key = (
+                    "compaction",
+                    "compaction_request_",
+                    "compaction_request_id",
+                )
+            else:
+                continue
+            call_id = payload[id_key]
+            key = (request_kind, call_id)
+            status = kind.removeprefix(prefix)
+            if status == "started":
+                if key in requests or payload["model"] != model:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "Duplicate request or changed model in usage trace"
+                    )
+                requests[key] = {
+                    "call_id": call_id,
+                    "kind": request_kind,
+                    "status": "started",
+                }
+                record["requests"].append(requests[key])
+                request_payloads[key] = saved(
+                    manifests[0].parent / payload["request_payload"]["path"]
+                )
+                body = request_payloads[key]
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(body, dict)
+                    or body.get("model") != model
+                    or not isinstance(body.get("input"), list)
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "Native request payload is missing or inconsistent"
+                    )
+                continue
+            request = requests[key]
+            if request["status"] != "started":
+                raise ValueError("Duplicate native request terminal record")
+            if status == "completed":
+                response = saved(
+                    manifests[0].parent / payload["response_payload"]["path"]
+                )
+                if not isinstance(response, dict):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "Native response payload is missing or inconsistent"
+                    )
+                if request_kind == "inference":
+                    if response["response_id"] != payload["response_id"]:
+                        raise ValueError("Native response identity changed")
+                    request["response_id"] = payload["response_id"]
+                if request_kind == "compaction" and not isinstance(
+                    response.get("output_items"), list
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError("Native compaction response has no output items")
+                if request_kind == "compaction" and response.get("token_usage") is None:
+                    request.update(
+                        status="unknown",
+                        error="Completed compaction has no complete usage counters",
+                    )
+                    estimate(request, key, response)
+                else:
+                    request.update(
+                        status="completed",
+                        usage=normalize_token_usage(response["token_usage"]),
+                    )
+            elif status in ("failed", "cancelled"):
+                error = payload.get("error", payload.get("reason", ""))
+                request.update(status="unknown", error=error)
+                partial = payload.get("partial_response_payload")
+                if partial is not None:
+                    partial_response = saved(manifests[0].parent / partial["path"])
+                    if not isinstance(partial_response, dict) or not isinstance(
+                        partial_response.get("output_items"), list
+                    ):
+                        raise ValueError("Native partial response has no output items")
+                    if partial_response.get("token_usage") is not None:
+                        request.update(
+                            status="accounted_failure",
+                            usage=normalize_token_usage(
+                                partial_response["token_usage"]
+                            ),
+                        )
+                    else:
+                        estimate(request, key, partial_response)
+                if status == "failed" and partial is None and rejected_request(error):
+                    request["status"] = "rejected"
+                elif (
+                    status == "failed"
+                    and partial is None
+                    and request_kind == "inference"
+                ):
+                    request.update(
+                        estimated_usage=dict.fromkeys(USAGE_FIELDS, 0),
+                        estimation_basis="failed_inference_without_partial_output_assumed_zero",
+                    )
+                elif partial is None:
+                    estimate(request, key, None)
+            else:
+                raise ValueError("Unsupported native request record")
+        if last_row is None or last_row["payload"]["type"] != "rollout_ended":
+            raise ValueError("Native usage trace has no terminal rollout record")
+        if not requests:
+            raise ValueError("Native usage trace contains no requests")
+    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as error:
+        reason = str(error)
+
+    total = dict.fromkeys(USAGE_FIELDS, 0)
+    inference_total = dict.fromkeys(USAGE_FIELDS, 0)
+    completed_inference_total = dict.fromkeys(USAGE_FIELDS, 0)
+    for request in requests.values():
+        for key, value in request.get("usage", {}).items():
+            total[key] += value
+            if request["kind"] == "inference":
+                inference_total[key] += value
+                if request["status"] == "completed":
+                    completed_inference_total[key] += value
+    record["token_usage"] = total
+    turns = [e for e in events if e.get("type") == "turn.completed"]
+    try:
+        # Current native finals omit remote compaction usage. Accept a future
+        # final including it only when complete per-request counters also agree.
+        if turns and (
+            len(turns) != 1
+            or normalize_token_usage(turns[0].get("usage"))
+            not in (completed_inference_total, inference_total, total)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Native request counters do not match terminal counters")
+    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
+        reason = reason or str(error)
+    unknown = [
+        request["call_id"]
+        for request in requests.values()
+        if request["status"] in ("unknown", "started")
+    ]
+    record.update(complete=reason is None and not unknown, unknown_request_ids=unknown)
+    if reason or unknown:
+        record["reason"] = reason or "Native requests have no complete usage counters"
+    ordered = list(requests.values())
+    for index, request in enumerate(ordered):
+        if (
+            request["kind"] != "compaction"
+            or request.get("error")
+            != "Completed compaction has no complete usage counters"
+        ):
+            continue
+        # Ciphertext size is a poor proxy for its underlying model tokens. Prefer
+        # observed context sizes on either side of the compaction. The next input
+        # also contains retained history, so this is a deliberately conservative
+        # proxy for compact output, not an observed compact response counter.
+        preceding = next(
+            (
+                other
+                for other in reversed(ordered[:index])
+                if other["kind"] == "inference" and other["status"] == "completed"
+            ),
+            None,
+        )
+        following = next(
+            (
+                other
+                for other in ordered[index + 1 :]
+                if other["kind"] == "inference" and other["status"] == "completed"
+            ),
+            None,
+        )
+        evidence = {}
+        if preceding is not None:
+            usage = preceding["usage"]
+            request["estimated_usage"]["input_tokens"] = (
+                usage["input_tokens"] + usage["output_tokens"]
+            )
+            evidence["input"] = {
+                "call_id": preceding["call_id"],
+                "counter": "input_tokens_plus_output_tokens",
+            }
+        if following is not None:
+            request["estimated_usage"]["output_tokens"] = following["usage"][
+                "input_tokens"
+            ]
+            evidence["output"] = {
+                "call_id": following["call_id"],
+                "counter": "input_tokens_including_retained_history",
+            }
+        if evidence:
+            request["estimation_basis"] = (
+                "neighboring_reported_context_tokens"
+                if preceding is not None and following is not None
+                else "reported_context_tokens_with_json_size_fallback"
+            )
+            request["estimation_evidence"] = evidence
+    estimated_total = total.copy()
+    estimates = []
+    for request in requests.values():
+        if "estimated_usage" not in request:
+            continue
+        for key, value in request["estimated_usage"].items():
+            estimated_total[key] += value
+        estimates.append(
+            {
+                "call_id": request["call_id"],
+                "kind": request["kind"],
+                "basis": request["estimation_basis"],
+                "token_usage": request["estimated_usage"],
+                **(
+                    {"evidence": request["estimation_evidence"]}
+                    if "estimation_evidence" in request
+                    else {}
+                ),
+            }
+        )
+    record.update(
+        structurally_valid=reason is None,
+        estimated_token_usage=estimated_total,
+        estimated_usage_complete=reason is None
+        and all(request["status"] != "started" for request in requests.values()),
+        usage_estimates=estimates,
+    )
+    return record
+
+
+def apply_usage(result: dict, record: dict) -> dict:
+    """Use reconciled request counters without changing the native task outcome."""
+    result = dict(result)
+    result.update(
+        response_usage_schema_version=record["schema_version"],
+        response_usage_sha256=fingerprint(record),
+        usage_complete=record["complete"],
+    )
+    if "token_usage" in record:
+        result["token_usage"] = record["token_usage"]
+    if record["schema_version"] == 2:
+        for key in (
+            "structurally_valid",
+            "estimated_token_usage",
+            "estimated_usage_complete",
+            "usage_estimates",
+        ):
+            result[key] = record[key]
+    if record["complete"]:
+        result.pop("usage_incomplete_reason", None)
+    else:
+        result["usage_incomplete_reason"] = record["reason"]
+    return result
+
+
+def reconcile_usage(
+    folder: Path,
+    events: list[dict],
+    model: str,
+    result: dict,
+    *,
+    schema_version: int = SCHEMA_VERSION,
+) -> dict:
+    """Persist host-owned accounting separately from the native workspace."""
+    record = collect_usage(folder, events, model, schema_version=schema_version)
+    write_json(folder / "response_usage.json", record)
+    return apply_usage(result, record)
+
+
+def audit_usage(folder: Path, events: list[dict], model: str, result: dict) -> dict:
+    """Rebuild accounting from pinned native evidence without model requests."""
+    record = read(folder / "response_usage.json")
+    if record != collect_usage(
+        folder, events, model, schema_version=record["schema_version"]
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("Native response usage evidence changed")
+    return apply_usage(result, record)

+"""Budget admission from explicit terminal usage estimates; no paid calls."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+import test_budget_tracking as budget_tests
+
+from proof_eval.evidence.io import read, write_json
+from proof_eval.harness import search
+from proof_eval.harness.tracking import attempt_cost, stop_decision
+from proof_eval.providers.costs import CostConfig, estimate_token_cost, generations_cost
+
+tracking_run = budget_tests.tracking_run
+
+MODEL, EFFORT = "gpt-6.1-sol", "max"
+REPORTED = dict(
+    input_tokens=100000,
+    cached_input_tokens=90000,
+    cache_write_input_tokens=0,
+    output_tokens=10000,
+    reasoning_output_tokens=5000,
+)
+MISSING = dict(
+    input_tokens=1000,
+    cached_input_tokens=0,
+    cache_write_input_tokens=0,
+    output_tokens=400,
+    reasoning_output_tokens=0,
+)
+
+
+def config(**fields):
+    return {
+        "provider": "codex",
+        "usage_policy": "best_effort",
+        "budget_tracking": "cost",
+        "budget_usd_per_problem": 3.0,
+        "max_budget_restarts": 20,
+        "max_transport_restarts": 2,
+        **fields,
+    }
+
+
+def incomplete_generation(**fields):
+    return {
+        "status": "received",
+        "provider": "codex",
+        "token_usage": REPORTED.copy(),
+        "usage_complete": False,
+        "response_usage_schema_version": 2,
+        "response_usage_sha256": "a" * 64,
+        "structurally_valid": True,
+        "estimated_usage_complete": True,
+        "estimated_token_usage": {
+            field: REPORTED[field] + MISSING[field] for field in REPORTED
+        },
+        "usage_estimates": [
+            {
+                "call_id": "native-compaction",
+                "kind": "compaction",
+                "basis": "request_and_response_json_characters_divided_by_four",
+                "token_usage": MISSING.copy(),
+            }
+        ],
+        **fields,
+    }
+
+
+def price(usage, model=MODEL):
+    return estimate_token_cost(CostConfig(model, EFFORT), usage)["total_usd"]
+
+
+def decision(settings, generation, cost, **fields):
+    return stop_decision(
+        settings,
+        generation,
+        cost,
+        **{
+            "unavailable": False,
+            "round_number": 0,
+            "time_remaining": None,
+            **fields,
+        },
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("policy", [None, "strict"])
+def test_historical_or_strict_policy_preserves_unknown_usage(policy):
+    settings = config()
+    if policy is None:
+        settings.pop("usage_policy")
+    else:
+        settings["usage_policy"] = policy
+    generation = incomplete_generation()
+    expected = generations_cost(CostConfig(MODEL, EFFORT), [generation])
+    actual = attempt_cost(settings, MODEL, EFFORT, [generation])
+    assert actual == expected
+    assert decision(settings, generation, actual)["kind"] == "unknown_usage"
+
+
+def test_complete_reported_cost_remains_identical():
+    generation = {"status": "received", "token_usage": REPORTED}
+    expected = generations_cost(CostConfig(MODEL, EFFORT), [generation])
+    assert attempt_cost(config(), MODEL, EFFORT, [generation]) == expected
+
+
+def test_best_effort_preserves_reported_lower_bound_and_prices_missing_usage():
+    generation = incomplete_generation()
+    actual = attempt_cost(config(), MODEL, EFFORT, [generation])
+    assert actual["status"] == "estimated_incomplete_usage"
+    assert actual["complete_usage"] is False
+    assert actual["reported_usage"] == REPORTED
+    assert actual["usage"] == generation["estimated_token_usage"]
+    assert actual["reported_total_usd"] == pytest.approx(price(REPORTED))
+    assert actual["total_usd"] == pytest.approx(price(REPORTED) + price(MISSING))
+    assert actual["estimated_unreported_usd"] == pytest.approx(price(MISSING))

+        return request_data
+
+    def completed(call_id, *, compact=False, usage=USAGE):
+        prefix = "compaction_request" if compact else "inference"
+        id_key = "compaction_request_id" if compact else "inference_call_id"
+        body = {"output_items": [{"type": "compaction", "encrypted_content": "abc"}]}

+            **extra,

  case var mem => cases mem

    right; rcases ihl rfl with vl | red

  case' tapp der sub ih =>
    right; rcases ih rfl with val | red
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := canonical_form_tabs val der
      exact ⟨_, .tabs val.lc sub.wf.2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp sub.wf.2.1.lc red.choose_spec⟩
  case' let' L der h ih _ =>
    have b := body_let.mp (Typing.let' L der h).wf.2.1
    right; rcases ih rfl with val | red
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body val b.2⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind red.choose_spec b.2⟩
  case' inl ih => exact (ih rfl).imp Value.inl fun red => ⟨_, .inl red.choose_spec⟩
  case' inr ih => exact (ih rfl).imp Value.inr fun red => ⟨_, .inr red.choose_spec⟩
  case' case L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    have b := body_case.mp (Typing.case L der h₂ h₃).wf.2.1
    right; rcases ih rfl with val | red
    · obtain ⟨_, rfl|rfl⟩ := canonical_form_sum val der
      · exact ⟨_, .case_inl (by cases val; assumption) b.2.1 b.2.2⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .case_inr (by cases val; assumption) b.2.1 b.2.2⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case red.choose_spec b.2.1 b.2.2⟩
  case' sub ih => exact ih rfl
  case' abs L h _ => exact .inl (.abs (Typing.abs L h).wf.2.1)
  case' tabs L h _ => exact .inl (.tabs (Typing.tabs L h).wf.2.1)
